sourceFile: 81. TIU L5S3-01 R Report Check Dry  F-pcb sub3 - L  2026.04.13_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable rows but mis-groups baseline and cross-line drying comparisons.
issues: Changed factor mixes line, normal settings, and transfer directions into one unclear comparison.
Baseline cites Line R with 305℃/11'40s, but that condition appears under Line L context.
Row 39 is compared to Line R normal though it likely belongs with Line L normal baseline.
Outcome direction for Line L to Line R may be wrong if compared against Line L normal results.
Dry time and temperature conditions are not preserved as primary grouping keys.
requiredUserQuestions: Should transfer samples be compared to source-line normal or destination-line normal?
Which Line L normal condition is the intended baseline: 305℃/10'32s or 305℃/11'40s?
correctionPlan: Rebuild changed factor as normal drying versus cross-line drying by transfer direction.
Preserve line, dry temperature, dry time, and transfer direction as grouping keys.
Use Line R normal 300℃/9'20s only for the R-to-L transfer comparison if justified.
Compare L-to-R transfer against the correct Line L normal baseline.
Recalculate judgement and deltas after regrouping.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist and cover context/results, but are insufficient until grouping is corrected.
